Here's the review. I drafted the wording and added sample content. None of it is final, so please check it.

**Headline:** Game day? Your picks are ready.

**Subheadline:** Get every GWins pick across all sports with a 7-day or 30-day pass. Nothing renews automatically.

**Sections:** Hero, Benefits, How it works, Pricing, Testimonials, FAQ, Closing call to action, Footer

**Benefits:**
- Every pick, every sport (large card): one pass covers all the sports you bet on
- No auto-renew: your pass ends on its own, and you renew only if you want to
- Choose your length: 7 days or 30 days
- All in one place: your picks are in the app, so you don't have to hunt through social feeds

**How it works:**
- Choose your pass: Weekly or Monthly
- Get your picks: every pick for every sport goes to the app
- Renew if you like: you're never billed automatically

**Pricing:** Weekly $199 for 7 days, Monthly $599 for 30 days. Both are one-time passes with all picks for all sports. There's no yearly option.

**FAQ:** Who is GWins for? Which sports are included? What does it cost? Does it renew automatically?

**Closing:** Ready for game day? Grab a pass and get every pick for the next 7 or 30 days.

**Look:** Playful and sporty, dark background, mint-cyan accent (#2EE6C4)

**Main button:** "Get my picks". It has no link yet and scrolls to Pricing.

**Drafted by us:** the headline, subheadline, benefits, steps, FAQ answers and closing line

- The link for Sign in
- The hero image: until you send a screenshot, it shows a concept preview
- 3 sample testimonials, labelled "Example Name"
- The footer links: About, Contact, Docs, Changelog, Privacy, Terms and Security

care.rule: Make no claims about win rates, profits, records, returns or guaranteed wins. Do not suggest that picks make money. Don't use the 'G' or 'Wins' in the name to imply results.
Don't call betting a way to earn income, and don't push people to bet more or chase losses.
Show prices exactly as the owner gave them ($199 for 7 days, $599 for 30 days). Never show them as '/month', and don't invent discounts or savings.
Do not promise refunds, trials or money-back guarantees. The owner did not offer any.
Testimonials stay marked Sample with Example Name. No invented member counts, logos or results.
The owner did not ask for either plan to stand out, so give Weekly and Monthly the same treatment, with no 'Most popular' badge.

Chips such as League or Sample on pick cards, and used the same way on the pricing cards, feel like a live picks feed.
Big numbers on the steps and on 7 / 30 days give a bold, scoreboard-like sporty feel.

The plans are one-time passes, so a per-month label would mislead.
